column3: クルックーが女神アリスに告げ口
column4: Crook is tattling to the goddess ALICE.

column3: あれ、いいんですか？　駄目でしょ、神として潰して下さい。
column4: That, is it okay? No way, please crush it as a god.

column3: 珍しいわね、貴方がそんな事を言うなんて、あれは特例なの
column4: That's unusual, for you to say that. That is an exception.

column3: \t・科学は認めない、科学を発展させない為に魔法を与えている
column4: - Science is not accepted; magic is given to prevent science from advancing.

column3: \t・科学は神の真理へ近づく、神と同じ事が出来るようになる危険な物
column4: - Science approaches the truth of God, a dangerous thing that could make one able to do what God does.

column3: \t・ある程度、近づくと必ず滅亡させる
column4: - Once it approaches a certain point, it will surely be destroyed.

column3: だけど、パイアールは別、彼の技術は進化しすぎで誰も理解出来ないし
column4: But Pi-R is different; his technology has evolved too much for anyone to understand.

column3: また彼も誰にも教える事が出来ない、彼だけで終わるオーパーツのような技術
column4: And he cannot teach it to anyone; it's like an out-of-place artifact technology that will end with just him.

column3: 世界に刺激を与えてくれるわ。それと・・・
column4: It will stimulate the world. And also...

column3: 私はひとつ可能性としても見ている、人間共がいなくなった時、次のメインプレイヤーに
column4: I also see one possibility: when humans disappear, the next main players.

column3: あの者が作る人工知能とかどうだろうかと、どんどん生産され殺し合い・・面白そうではないか
column4: How about the artificial intelligence he creates, produced more and more, killing each other... wouldn't that be interesting?
